SPIRITS_CHEERS.title: Cheers!
SPIRITS_CHEERS.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()}.
Choose a teammate. They take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_PEER_PRESSURE.title: Peer Pressure
SPIRITS_PEER_PRESSURE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()}.
Choose a teammate. They take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_LIQUID_COURAGE.title: Liquid Courage
SPIRITS_HAIR_OF_THE_DOG.title: Hair of the Dog
SPIRITS_ROUND_ON_ME.title: Round on Me
SPIRITS_ROUND_ON_ME.description:
ALL players gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[gold]Everyone[/gold] takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_DESIGNATED_DRIVER.title: Designated Driver
SPIRITS_DESIGNATED_DRIVER.description:
You are immune to penalties this combat. Water still counts.
Can't be played while you're the Drunk Driver.
SPIRITS_BOTTOMS_UP.title: Bottoms Up
SPIRITS_BOTTOMS_UP.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()}. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
Choose a teammate. They take {Sips:diff()} [gold]Sips[/gold].
SPIRITS_LAST_CALL.title: Last Call
SPIRITS_DRUNK_DRIVER.title: Drunk Driver
SPIRITS_DRUNK_DRIVER.description:
At the start of your turn, deal damage equal to a quarter of your [gold]Tipsy[/gold] (max {MaxDamage:diff()}) to a random enemy.
Can't be played while you're the Designated Driver.
SPIRITS_BOTTOMLESS_MIMOSAS.title: Bottomless Mimosas
SPIRITS_BOTTOMLESS_MIMOSAS.description:
Take X [gold]Sips[/gold].
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage per hit for every 15 [gold]Tipsy[/gold].
SPIRITS_BLACKOUT.title: Blackout
SPIRITS_BLACKOUT.description:
Take {Sips:diff()} [gold]Sips[/gold].
Play the top card of your draw pile once for every 8 [gold]Tipsy[/gold] (max 8) and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] them.
End your turn.
SPIRITS_TAKE_ONE_FOR_THE_TEAM.title: Take One for the Team
SPIRITS_TAKE_ONE_FOR_THE_TEAM.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Choose a teammate. The next penalty they would receive comes to you instead.
SPIRITS_WATER_BREAK.title: Water Break
SPIRITS_HAPPY_HOUR.title: Happy Hour
SPIRITS_HAPPY_HOUR.description: Whenever you take a [gold]Sip[/gold], draw 1 card.
SPIRITS_DOUBLE_SHOT.title: Take the Shot
SPIRITS_DOUBLE_SHOT.description:
Take 3 [gold]Sips[/gold].
Deal damage equal to {Multiplier:diff()}x your [gold]Tipsy[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SPIRITS_SPILL.title: Spill
SPIRITS_DRUNK_TEXT.title: Drunk Text
SPIRITS_DRUNK_TEXT.description: When drawn, a random teammate takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_HICCUPS.title: Hiccups
SPIRITS_HICCUPS.description: While in your hand, every 3rd card you play makes you take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_BAR_FLY.title: Bar Fly
SPIRITS_BAR_FLY.description: When drawn, take a [gold]Sip[/gold]. Then it flies off into a random teammate's draw pile.
SPIRITS_STICKY_FLOOR.title: Sticky Floor
SPIRITS_HANGOVER.title: Hangover
SPIRITS_HANGOVER.description: When drawn, lose 1 Energy and take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_BEER_GOGGLES.title: Beer Goggles
SPIRITS_BEER_GOGGLES.description:
When drawn, take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
While in your hand, your attacks hit random enemies.
SPIRITS_FUZZY_MEMORY.title: Fuzzy Memory
SPIRITS_FUZZY_MEMORY.description: When drawn, take a [gold]Sip[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card in your hand.
SPIRITS_KEG_STAND.title: Down the Hatch
SPIRITS_KEG_STAND.description:
Take {Sips:diff()} [gold]Sips[/gold].
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for every 2 [gold]Tipsy[/gold].
SPIRITS_SLIP_AWAY.title: Slip Away
SPIRITS_SLIP_AWAY.description:
The next penalty you would receive is passed to a random teammate.
Draw {Cards:diff()}.
SPIRITS_LIQUID_COOLING.title: Liquid Cooling
SPIRITS_ROYAL_DECREE.title: Royal Decree
SPIRITS_ROYAL_DECREE.description:
Gain {Stars:diff()} [gold]Stars[/gold].
Choose a teammate. They take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_POUR_ONE_OUT.title: Pour One Out
SPIRITS_POUR_ONE_OUT.description:
Can only be played if a teammate has died.
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Everyone[/gold] takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_DRINKING_SONG.title: Drinking Song
SPIRITS_DRINKING_SONG.description:
ALL players gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[gold]Everyone[/gold] takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_BAR_FIGHT.title: Bar Fight
SPIRITS_BAR_FIGHT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have 15 or more [gold]Tipsy[/gold], hit ALL enemies instead.
SPIRITS_BEER_MUSCLES.title: Beer Muscles
SPIRITS_DREGS.title: Dregs
SPIRITS_DINE_AND_DASH.title: Dine and Dash
SPIRITS_DINE_AND_DASH.description: This combat, the first penalty you would receive each turn goes to a random teammate.
SPIRITS_ELECTROLYTES.title: Electrolytes
SPIRITS_BRAIN_FREEZE.title: Brain Freeze
SPIRITS_ROYAL_POUR.title: Royal Pour
SPIRITS_OPEN_BAR.title: Open Bar
SPIRITS_OPEN_BAR.description:
Gain {Stars:diff()} [gold]Stars[/gold] for each living player.
[gold]Everyone[/gold] takes a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_RAISE_GLASS.title: Raise a Glass
SPIRITS_WAKE.title: Wake
SPIRITS_KARAOKE_DUET.title: Karaoke Duet
SPIRITS_KARAOKE_DUET.description:
You and a teammate gain {Block:diff()} Block.
They take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
SPIRITS_DRUNKEN_BALLAD.title: Drunken Ballad
SPIRITS_DRUNKEN_BALLAD.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each drink anyone has taken this combat.
SPIRITS_PASS_THE_BOTTLE.title: Pass the Bottle
SPIRITS_PASS_THE_BOTTLE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()}. Take a [gold]Sip[/gold].
Draws 1 more each time it's played this combat (max 4).
Then it goes into a random teammate's draw pile.
SPIRITS_PREGAME.title: Pregame
SPIRITS_PREGAME.description:
Shuffle 2 [gold]Sips[/gold] into your draw pile.
Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
SPIRITS_WATER.title: Water
SPIRITS_SIP.title: Sip
SPIRITS_SHOT.title: Shot
SPIRITS_CHUG.title: Chug
SPIRITS_FINISH_YOUR_DRINK.title: Finish Your Drink
